channel.name: Purple Grape Drama
channel.description:
💕Welcome to [Purple Grape Drama]💕

This is a small channel focused on female-oriented short dramas, mainly featuring full versions. Each drama is released all at once in full—no choppy fragments, and no making you search everywhere for the rest halfway through.

I love delicate, tender emotional storylines with emotional ups and downs, and I also love watching two people gradually grow closer as they spend time together. The channel will keep updating, and I hope you can find stories here that are perfect for watching before bed, during your commute, or while relaxing on weekends.

Subscribe and turn on the little bell 🔔 so you’ll see new dramas as soon as they’re released. You’re also welcome to make requests in the comments and tell me what direction you’d like to see. Let’s quietly binge-watch dramas together and fall in love little by little. 🍬🌷
